description:
pace Mission Design Game:

A Space Mission Design Game is an educational game where players design rockets, plan space missions, explore planets, and launch spacecraft
summary: A Space Mission Design Game is an interactive simulation where players design, manage, and operate a full space mission—choosing spacecraft components, instruments, launch vehicles, orbits, and budgets—using realistic NASA-inspired constraints and data.
